description: Restrict attachment downloads based on category Access Topics privilege. Files uploaded to posts in restricted categories are only downloadable by users with the Access Topics permission on that category.
settings.title: Settings
settings.enabled-hint: When enabled, downloads of files uploaded to posts are only allowed for users who have the Access Topics (topics:read) permission on the file's category, for both per-group and per-user privileges. Disable to allow all downloads regardless of category privileges.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.reset-note: Statistics are in-memory counters and reset on every server restart.
saved-on: Settings saved. The attachment privilege guard is now active.
saved-off: Settings saved. The attachment privilege guard is now disabled.
